Migraine

Ailment headache neurological neurovascular

Evidence: scientific

Summary

Recurrent severe headaches often with visual disturbances, nausea, and sensitivity to light and sound.

Symptoms

  • severe headache
  • nausea
  • photophobia
  • phonophobia
  • visual aura

Affected Body Systems

  • nervous
  • vascular

Severity Levels

  • mild
  • moderate
  • severe

Related Conditions

  • Arthritis
    Inflammatory joint disease; managed with dietary and herbal interventions.
  • Gallbladder Issues / Gallstones
    Gallbladder dysfunction or gallstone formation causing digestion problems, bloating, and referred pain. Often linked to liver congestion.
  • Asthma
    Chronic inflammatory disease of the airways that causes wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, and coughing.
  • Eczema & Skin Disorders
    Chronic inflammatory skin conditions causing dry, itchy, inflamed skin; includes eczema, psoriasis, and dermatitis.
  • Cardiovascular Disease
    Group of diseases affecting the heart and blood vessels, including coronary artery disease, heart failure, and stroke.
  • Blood Sugar Imbalance
    Imbalances in blood sugar regulation, including hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia.
  • Digestive Discomfort
    General digestive discomfort including bloating, gas, and indigestion.
  • Immune System Weakness
    Weakened immune system leading to frequent infections and slow recovery.
  • Thyroid Dysfunction
    Underactive or overactive thyroid gland leading to hormonal imbalance and metabolic issues.
  • Menopause Transition
    Hormonal changes during the menopausal transition causing various symptoms.
  • Chemical Sensitivity
    Heightened sensitivity to chemicals, environmental toxins, and food additives that trigger immune responses.
  • Allergic Rhinitis
    Allergic inflammation of the nasal passages causing sneezing, congestion, and itching.
  • High Cholesterol
    Elevated cholesterol levels in the blood, increasing risk of cardiovascular disease.
  • High Blood Pressure
    Chronically elevated blood pressure requiring management.
